requirements_summary: Mid-market B2B search SaaS building a product recommendations & support search feature. They need a rerank endpoint that can be used both in real-time (p99 latency target ~60-120ms depending on query complexity) and for offline batch scoring across nightly pipelines. Primary goals: improve relevance precision@5, raise NDCG across business verticals, and reduce manual tuning time. Cost sensitive; evaluating Hosted for quick integration then Dedicated for consistent throughput and data isolation.
